zh.title: 卖方 Escrow 与 Closing：从接受 Offer 到拿到房款
zh.seo_title: 卖方 Escrow 与 Closing 流程｜陈靖
zh.description: 接受 Offer 之后还有很多事。本文按顺序说明卖方在 Escrow 里要做什么：Disclosure、验房和修理谈判、贷款还清、转让税、加州 3⅓% 预扣、FIRPTA，以及交房和拿到房款的安排。
zh.lead: Escrow 是买卖双方把钱和文件交给中立第三方、按合同完成交易的过程。卖方要做的事不少，提前知道顺序就不容易乱。

en.title: Seller Escrow and Closing: From Acceptance to Proceeds
en.seo_title: Seller Escrow and Closing in California | Jing Chen
en.description: What sellers do in escrow, step by step: disclosures, repair requests, loan payoff, transfer tax, California withholding, FIRPTA and keys.
en.lead: Escrow is the neutral process that holds money and documents until the contract terms are met. Sellers have plenty to do, and knowing the order helps.
